const Jumble ops.RedactStrategy

type JumbleMode = JumbleMode
const JumbleSmart ops.JumbleMode
const JumbleTypeAware ops.JumbleMode
const Mask ops.RedactStrategy
const Nil ops.RedactStrategy

type Span struct{Start int; End int; Category string; Original string}
type Strategy = Strategy
func Text(ctx context.Context, text string, options ...TextOptions) (TextResult, error)
type TextOptions struct{embedded schemaflux.Options; Categories []string; MaskChar rune; ShowFirst int; ShowLast int; MinMask int}
type TextResult struct{Text string; Original string; Spans []Span; Categories map[string]int; DetectorSpans int; LeftInsideWords int}
func Value[T any](input T, options ...ValueOptions) (T, error)
type ValueOptions struct{Categories []string; Strategy Strategy; MaskText string; MaskChar rune; MaskLength int; JumbleSeed int64; JumbleMode JumbleMode; CustomPatterns []string}
